I live in a small apartment that doesn't have washer/dryer hookups, so this vent is just what I needed to install a small dryer. I shopped around quite a bit and didn't find a better price than this anywhere. It was easy to install so I had my dryer up and running in about 10 minutes.
The ventilation kit greatly improves the air circulation in my dryer. It dries faster!
The PVC material is extremely durable. It shows no signs of damage even with constant use.
We installed it immediately and it has helped us wash and dry laundry at anytime, super versatile and useful.

My husband always wants the “commercial kitchen version” of everything. This was the perfect upgrade to our farmhouse sink. We both love it!

High quality faucet. I bought for my kitchen sink but decided the highly commercial look and features would suit my basement utility sink so I used it there. This is better than anything I've ever bought from the box stores and it really doesn't cost any more than ones that have less features and a whole lot less water pressure. It looks fantastic in a utility setting and I would have been fine with it in my kitchen until I found a similar unit that looked more residential. So I bought both and kept them both and have no complaints. Game changer, it fills sinks probably 3xs as fast as my old faucet and the sprayer is similar to a shower head.
